gaps: Phase 1 still-port: label, change chip, and context render as static text. The directional Swap (rise from below on increase, drop from above on decrease, blur, popLayout), the width-morph spring on the change chip (ResizeObserver + animate(width)), and the AnimatedCounter digit roll are Phase 2.
The .swap/.swapBlock/.text/.sizer hooks and data-trend (up on leading '+', down on leading '-' or U+2212, matching ARC) are kept so Phase 2 wires motion without restructuring.
Imports the PORTED AnimatedCounter ($lib/components/animated-counter/animated-counter.svelte), not the ARC one; passes animateOnView through like ARC.
Reduced-motion path is inherently satisfied in Phase 1 (static end state); Phase 2 must branch on reduced motion like ARC (fade variants, duration-0 transitions).
